accomplishments.statement: Assisted with writing Python tests for at least 10 internal endpoints under supervision. The work I did was writing these tests, and those tests checked successful requests as well as invalid requests. I did not own the service; my contribution was the supervised testing work just described.

review_focus: A readable rewrite can combine repeated descriptions of the testing task.
Retain assistance, supervision, at least 10, both request outcomes and explicit non-ownership.
